I experienced this glitch 3 times yesterday (I was invisible). I saved my log. I don't have a Github so here is the txt file from Dropbox. It's quite long since I experienced it 3 times in 3 different worlds before deciding to log out.
https://www.dropbox.com/s/407p4tpstrpiay4/output_log_10-30-29_problemstart.txt?dl=0

Another thing I just realized I wanted to point out in case it could be useful info. Whenever someone joins the instance but is non-existant, I do not get a join notification for them in the XSOverlay log parser. At least from what I remember. Will be on the lookout some more for this.
this is happening again, it happened on 6/18/2021 on one of my friends back at the skyhouse... and it happened again today.

So i keep having this same problem where people cant see me when i join. Sometimes only few can and other times no one or everyone can.. idk how to fix this. 
And no i do not mean just the avatar, i mean everything, username and avatar and cant hear me either. I constantly have to reload the world ot leave and join back or sometimes even restart the game. Its really annoying and i have to constantly ask people if they can see me. And sometimes when i talk to a friend (if they can see me) others sometimes say who are you talking to. And when playing games like murder four, i get kicked because my character is “invisible” and claimed as hacking. I need this fixed
Recently happened to me on 6/24/2021. Nobody could see me and I had to rejoin the instance multiple times just to get it working.
As noted in their most recent patch, mitigations have been put in place to prevent this issue from occurring. It's still being investigated though.

While this is highly upvoted and being worked on, I'd like to take the opportunity to plug another related issue (see my last comment on it, not issue text): https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/1095-avatars-with-chairs-cause-players-to-be-stuck-on-spawnorigin-for-late-joine
TLDR is that an avatar with enough chairs and index controllers will make you appear frozen to remote users, so you can roam the world freely and listen in on conversations, while being completely invisible and inaudible (because you're stuck frozen on spawn for remote players).

Certain worlds tend to invoke it constantly. A good example is the TonboBattleField. You may need 10+ users to trigger in, but it's intermittent and affects certain people. I noticed targeting when and setting hide and show avatar can fix it after they disappear, but when you're playing a game world, that can be terrible. It doesn't seem to affect Lasertag as much but I've seen it happen there.
When it comes to private convos, though. Really, assume you're never save, take it to invite only.

Out of curiosity, how many people have observed this _directly_ lately in Live? Please don't telephone game reports-- I'm interested in verifiable, definite "Yes, I couldn't see this person until I muted/unmuted someone else" reports.
I haven't heard or seen any further reports of this issue and I think we might've squashed it with some other, related changes.

details:
At unpredictable times, players will disappear completely in an instance, not be visible, have a name plate, make any audio, appear on the social list, and apparently won't have any local simulation data associated with them.
Beyond the obvious frustration and confusion that this causes, it causes a somewhat significant lack of confidence for personal privacy.
It becomes difficult to be assured of who is and is not present and listening to private conversations. Please address this.
title: Hidden, invisible, inaudible players and privacy concerns
